item.title: Lent begins this week, with Ash Wednesday starting a period of fasting, reflection
item.description: This is the week of Ash Wednesday, a solemn day of fasting and reflection that signals the start of Lent, the most penitential season of the church calendar for Catholics and many other Christians.

item.title: More states roll out SNAP restrictions this week. Is NY next?
item.description: It's part of a growing movement to ban the purchase of sugary drinks and candy with federal food benefits.

item.title: 'Half-daylight saving time' could become permanent under new bill
item.description: Wish you were only losing a half-hour of sleep in March? A new bill in Congress could make that a reality.

item.title: Episcopalians celebrate Ash Wednesday with 'ashes to go' and a call for political unity
item.description: The Episcopal Diocese of Central New York held two public prayer gatherings on Ash Wednesday, one of which was held outside of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) field office in Mattydale, in an effort to promote unity and honor the dignity of immigrants and refugees.

item.title: Cleanup continues in Boonville after church explosion
item.description: An explosion and fire destroyed the Abundant Life Church in Boonville after heavy snow caused a roof to slump and damage a propane fuel line, resulting in one firefighter being thrown against a wall and requiring assistance from emergency crews across the region to extinguish.
